---
title: "Step 2 — Chart"
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-step2
#| fig-cap: "EXAMPLE DATA — regional split (synthetic)."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("data/example_generation.csv")
summary = df.groupby("region", as_index=False)["mwh"].sum()
fig = px.pie(summary, names="region", values="mwh", title="EXAMPLE: share by region")
fig
```
